description: Legal Affairs Department - The Societies Ordinance ( Especially the Empowered 7 Unions)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Finance exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance to authorize purposes for specific societies and limit the application of the ordinance. This constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of Basil Rajapaksha as Minister is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
